experiment: DB3V as an alternative baseline training dataset
status: Diagnostic only; excluded from formal baseline selection
task: Eight-class single-label recording classification with softmax and categorical cross-entropy

external_test.relationship_to_training: Independent dataset; no BirdSet clip was used for training or model selection

limitations: All three DB3V regions occur in both training and validation.
The internal validation result measures same-region holdout recognition, not unseen-region generalization.
Training on DB3V consumes the target regional domain and invalidates DB3V's role as an independent regional generalization test.
